mapper.insert:
insert into CBondEODPrices (OBJECT_ID, S_INFO_WINDCODE, TRADE_DT, CRNCY_CODE, S_DQ_PRECLOSE, S_DQ_OPEN, S_DQ_HIGH, S_DQ_LOW, S_DQ_CLOSE, S_DQ_CHANGE, S_DQ_PCTCHANGE, S_DQ_VOLUME, S_DQ_AMOUNT, S_DQ_AVGPRICE, S_DQ_TRADESTATUS,OPDATE,OPMODE ) values
(#{item.objectId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sInfoWindcode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.tradeDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.crncyCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sDqPreclose,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sDqOpen,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sDqHigh,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sDqLow,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sDqClose,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sDqChange,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sDqPctchange,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sDqVolume,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sDqAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sDqAvgprice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.sDqTradestatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.opdate,jdbcType=DATE},#{item.opmode,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select A.OBJECT_ID, A.S_INFO_WINDCODE, date_format(STR_TO_DATE(A.TRADE_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') TRADE_DT, A.CRNCY_CODE, A.S_DQ_PRECLOSE, A.S_DQ_OPEN, A.S_DQ_HIGH, A.S_DQ_LOW, A.S_DQ_CLOSE, A.S_DQ_CHANGE, ifnull(A.S_DQ_PCTCHANGE/100,NULL) S_DQ_PCTCHANGE, A.S_DQ_VOLUME, ifnull(A.S_DQ_AMOUNT*1000,NULL) S_DQ_AMOUNT, A.S_DQ_AVGPRICE, A.S_DQ_TRADESTATUS, A.OPDATE,A.OPMODE from CBondEODPrices A WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT B WHERE B.FINPROD_TYPE='F01' AND A.S_INFO_WINDCODE = B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ) AND A.TRADE_DT = #{cdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
